singleLock: CredentialVaultHost application lease plus persistent rejected-owner application fence

NEW_OWNER_STARTING.recovery: terminate failed child and recover owner

NEW_OWNER_HYDRATING.fd6: must bind to same owner generation

REJECTED_OWNER_TERMINATION_PENDING.recovery: require stopped=true, exitConfirmed=true and owner recovery

REJECTED_OWNER_STILL_LIVE.owner: rejected child still live and untrusted
REJECTED_OWNER_STILL_LIVE.recovery: retain global application fence until real exit

FATAL_OWNER_CONTAINMENT.owner: untrusted rejected child may still live
FATAL_OWNER_CONTAINMENT.recovery: shutdown or observed real exit followed by owner recovery

FAILED_SAFE.owner: must be absent before any new normal operation; a live or retained owner requires containment/recovery states
FAILED_SAFE.fd6: closed; reset to IDLE is blocked until the owner-free ACTIVE boundary is verified
FAILED_SAFE.recovery: only return to IDLE after child exit, owner-exit recovery, empty owner/transaction state, closed FD6, empty DesktopHost ownership and ACTIVE authority verification

successBoundary: durable mutation COMMITTED or durable replay
interruptionRule: Any non-stable persisted operation is restored as FAILED_SAFE. Rejected-owner containment states remain durable across coordinator/application restart and retain the application fence until real child exit and owner recovery.
shutdownRule: Application shutdown is checked before the lease, before mutation commit and before new-owner start.
controlledExitRule: Expected old-owner exits suppress the independent automatic restart path.
containmentRule: READY or runtime projection rejection engages a persistent application fence before cleanup. Cleanup failure enters FATAL_OWNER_CONTAINMENT and blocks FD6, UI mutation, start, restart, hydration and owner acceptance.
enforcementOrderingRule: READY or runtime projection rejection first revokes BackendProcessHost owner/API authority, detaches and closes FD6, and installs the independent CredentialVaultHost application fence. Only after verified enforcement may lifecycle or containment journals be written.
durableDiscoveryRule: Coordinator journal, independent containment sentinel, and backend owner registry are separate discovery sources. Corruption or absence of any one source fails closed when another source indicates an active or unverified owner.
